20 Best Weeknight Dinners to Keep in Your Back Pocket

Bookmark these recipes for stress-free weeknights.
By
 Theodora Kaloudis
Theodora Kaloudis
Theodora's passion for cooking began early on as a young girl, working in the kitchen at her father's Greek diner in Brooklyn, NY. Her recipes have appeared on Delish, Spruce Eats, Today.com, Martha Stewart & Marley Spoon, Dinnerly, Simply Recipes, and in various cookbooks.

regions.text: What makes for the best weeknight dinner recipes? For us, it's all about meals that are quick to pull together, use simple ingredients, and deliver big on flavor—no fussy techniques or hours in the kitchen required. That's why we've rounded up this all-star lineup of trusty recipes, which include quick 30-minute or less meals, minimal-ingredient dishes, and skillet, sheet pan, and one-pot wonders.

Rice Carbonara

 Stovetop Stuffed Shells 
 Simply Recipes / Sara Haas
Stovetop Stuffed Shells
 "There's no need to turn on the oven with this easy (and quicker) recipe. It starts with cooking the shells, which should be very al dente so they're easier to fill and don't end up overcooked. A ricotta and parmesan filling are added and the shells are arranged atop store-bought marinara." —Sara Haas, Recipe D

 Sheet Pan Pierogi With Sausage 
 Simply Recipes / Frank Tiu
Sheet Pan Pierogi With Sausage
 "Customize the sausage: Kielbasa is a convenient weeknight staple because it's already cooked, flavorful, and readily available. But this recipe is incredibly flexible. I've made it with great success with chorizo and turkey sausage, as well." —Kris Osborne, Recipe Developer

20-Minute Chicken Enchilada Chili

Quick and Easy Pad Thai

 Sheet Pan Salmon Dinner With Feta Sauce 
 Simply Recipes / Ciara Kehoe
Sheet Pan Salmon Dinner With Feta Sauce
 "Ease is the name of the game with this delectable salmon sheet pan dinner, where minimal prep and a tight ingredient list are key. You can get everything prepped and roasting in about 5 minutes, then let the oven work its magic." —Theodora Kaloudis, Recipe Developer

 Easy Beef Krapow (Thai Basil Beef) 
 Simply Recipes / Frank Tiu
Easy Beef Krapow (Thai Basil Beef)
 "This recipe calls for Thai basil, which has a minty, floral aroma that is very distinctively delicious and iconic to this dish. If you cannot find it at your local Asian supermarket, feel free to use sweet basil since it is more readily available." —Frank Tiu, Recipe Developer

 Skillet Lasagna

Skillet Lasagna
 "Build flavor with Italian sausage: Italian sausage has all the herbs and spices built right in, so you don't have to add them one by one.  Easy Sheet Pan Chicken Fajitas 
 Simply Recipes / Frank Tiu
Easy Sheet Pan Chicken Fajitas
 "Make sure you don't get the food too close to the heating element; 4 to 6 inches away is perfect. Line the sheet pan with foil to make cleanup easier, too—you'll only have a cutting board, knife, and one mixing bowl to scrub." —Deborah Koenig, Recipe Developer

 One-Pan Garlic Butter Shrimp Pasta 
 Simply Recipes / Mark Beahm
One-Pan Garlic Butter Shrimp Pasta
 "With only a few ingredients and minimal prep, this one-pan garlic and butter shrimp pasta has been a consistent hit with my family. My son loves shrimp, my partner—a pasta aficionado—is pleased, and I love a simple dinner I can pull together after weeknight activities." —Lou Perseghin, R

 Sheet Pan Chicken Caesar Salad 
 Simply Recipes / Sara Haas, RDN
Sheet Pan Chicken Caesar Salad
 "To keep things simple, I buy chicken cutlets. The thinner cut helps the chicken cook quickly, preventing it from drying and turning rubbery. I use the same olive oil mixture on the chicken (to keep it moist) and the croutons (making them crispy)." —Sara Haas, Recipe Developer

images.alt: Sheet pan caesar salad on a platter with a bowl of fresh parmesan, salad utensils, and a beige table napkin

 Cheesy Hamburger Pasta Skillet 
 Simply Recipes / Ciara Kehoe
Cheesy Hamburger Pasta Skillet
 "This recipe comes from years of experience with one-pot, minimal-ingredient pastas. The base is ground beef and pasta, but it only needs a handful of other ingredients to come together: canned tomatoes, broth, cheese, and a little cream." —Meghan Splawn, Recipe Developer

images.alt: A top view of a skillet with the Cheesy Hamburger Skillet Recipe

 Turkey Taco Bowls 
 Simply Recipes / Photo by Fred Hardy II / Food Styling by Ana Kelly / Prop Styling by Shell Royster
Turkey Taco Bowls
 "For our vegetarian friends, we love draining extra-firm tofu, grating it on the large holes of a box grater, and sauteing it in a pan! The resulting texture is very similar to ground turkey." —Laurel Randolph, Associate Editorial Director

images.alt: Plate of 5-ingredient turkey taco bowl at a table setting with a glass of water and a bowl of lime wedges

 Easy Chickpea Curry

Easy Chickpea Curry

 One-Pan Garlic Chicken and Potatoes

One-Pan Garlic Chicken and Potatoes
 "To keep the meal low-maintenance, I often roast broccoli, Brussels sprouts, or other hearty vegetables on a baking sheet on the top rack of the oven while the chicken cooks. A big salad is a great side for this dish, as is crusty bread!" —S

 Simply Recipes
Baked Fish With Parmesan Breadcrumbs
 "Serve it straight from the dish in wedges—don't try to serve individual fillets since the thin pieces of fish tend to melt together in the oven. Nothing fancy—just good cheese, fresh fish, and company to share it with." —Sally Vargas, Recipe Developer
